meta.title: Repetition Guard
meta.description: Guards DeepSeek Harness streamed output against repetition: when the same string repeats up to the threshold (10 by default) it opens a decision card while output keeps streaming; stop now, or allow this call to continue; without action it stops only after the repeats reach threshold x multiplier and the minimum reaction time has passed, and commits the partial answer. Local providers are not force-stopped by default (the card still appears; only a manual stop ends the call). An optional pause-display mode holds the hit chunk (display only; server-side compute is not paused). Fenced, inline and indented code share one relaxed threshold (threshold x codeBlockMultiplier); repeat counts can follow unit length through a piecewise table or a JS module; the whitelist, detection window and table-derived unit lengths are written back automatically, so settings changes need no restart. Stop notices offer an optional continue instruction and an opt-in browser system notification. Verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (CLI and desktop), host API >= 0.1.1.
